related.title: ZooKeeper：session、ephemeral 節點與 fencing
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：在三個 acceptor 的 Phase 1 回覆中選擇必須繼承的值。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Choose the value a proposer must inherit from Phase 1 responses of three acceptors. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 描述持鎖程序暫停後 session 過期，再恢復時如何阻止過期寫入。
related.differenceEn: Model a paused holder whose session expires and show how to reject stale writes after it resumes.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 若 prepare quorum 包含已接受提案，選最高 accepted ballot 的值；promise 與 accepted 記錄不同。 教學基準：max(4,7) = 7 highest accepted ballot；第二檢核：floor(3/2)+1 = 2 quorum size。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。

Ephemeral 節點跟隨 session 生命周期；外部資源若只看鎖存在仍可能接受過期持有者，需驗 fencing token。 教學基準：42-41 = 1 token advancement；第二檢核：max(41,42) = 42 minimum current accepted token。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: When a prepare quorum reports accepted proposals,choose the value with the highest accepted ballot; promised and accepted records differ. Teaching baseline: max(4,7) = 7 highest accepted ballot; second check: floor(3/2)+1 = 2 quorum size. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Ephemerals follow session lifetimes; external resources can still accept a stale holder unless they check fencing tokens. Teaching baseline: 42-41 = 1 token advancement; second check: max(41,42) = 42 minimum current accepted token. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: RabbitMQ：publisher confirms 與 consumer ACK
related.titleEn: RabbitMQ: publisher confirms versus consumer ACKs
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：在三個 acceptor 的 Phase 1 回覆中選擇必須繼承的值。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Choose the value a proposer must inherit from Phase 1 responses of three acceptors. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 在四個階段標示訊息責任，避免把 broker confirm 當作消費者完成。
related.differenceEn: Track responsibility across four stages without mistaking broker confirmation for consumer completion.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 若 prepare quorum 包含已接受提案，選最高 accepted ballot 的值；promise 與 accepted 記錄不同。 教學基準：max(4,7) = 7 highest accepted ballot；第二檢核：floor(3/2)+1 = 2 quorum size。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
Publisher confirm 與 consumer ACK 是兩個獨立邊界；連線中斷時可能需要重送與去重。 教學基準：10-7 = 3 unacknowledged messages；第二檢核：7/10*100 = 70 consumer completion percent。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: When a prepare quorum reports accepted proposals,choose the value with the highest accepted ballot; promised and accepted records differ. Teaching baseline: max(4,7) = 7 highest accepted ballot; second check: floor(3/2)+1 = 2 quorum size. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Publisher confirms and consumer ACKs are distinct boundaries; connection loss may require retransmission and deduplication. Teaching baseline: 10-7 = 3 unacknowledged messages; second check: 7/10*100 = 70 consumer completion percent. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
